summary.zh-CN: 合并用户已授权使用的本地完整汉化补丁 V2 资源，选择核心原生 chs 剧本、配置、G01 图像和 mov_chs 影片。仅合并资源，机器码行为保持不变，五处原汉化启动器的 RVA 修改未实现。需用户提供游戏及中文资源，不包含游戏素材、翻译正文或字体。
summary.en: Merges user-authorized local Complete Chinese Patch V2 resources using the core's native chs scripts, configuration, G01 images and mov_chs movies. Resource merge only: machine-code behavior is unchanged and the original Chinese launcher's five RVA patches are not implemented. Requires local game and Chinese resources; includes no game assets, translated text or fonts.

releases.edition: Unofficial 2017 A·T·Field Simplified Chinese patch (完整汉化补丁 V2); installed Chinese edition, not a clean Japanese release
